scope: Current factual Varrock Museum contribution mechanics relevant to the 100-Kudos Bone Voyage gate: the Natural History Quiz, Digsite uncleaned-find displays, and Historian Minas timeline claims. This record separates fixed awards from random discovery and does not prescribe a route or automatically complete eligible quests or claims.

source_catalog.used_for: Current Kudos thresholds and maxima, Natural History Quiz mechanics and completion XP, Digsite cleaning access/tools/displays, Historian Minas claim table, lamp amounts, and Bone Voyage's current 100-Kudos gate.
The Dig Site completion as the cleaning prerequisite; current boostable skill gates and fixed quest XP relevant to that prerequisite.
Current Bone Voyage requirement relationship: The Dig Site completion plus at least 100 Kudos.

records.name: Varrock Museum Kudos paths before Bone Voyage

membership.note: The 100-Kudos Bone Voyage gate is a members progression gate. The Museum's only free-to-play Kudos source is ancient relic donation, which is outside this record's scope.

kudos_counter.rule: Kudos can be acquired but are never spent.

current_maxima.boundary: The 235 total also includes 72 fossil-display Kudos that require Bone Voyage/Fossil Island and five Camdozaal ancient-relic Kudos; it is not a pre-Bone Voyage total. The covered 158 is an available maximum, not a claim that any listed quest, random find, or Minas conversation has occurred.

natural_history_quiz.start: Talk to Orlando Smith and receive the lecture before answering display plaques.

fixed_completion_experience.claim_condition: Complete all 14 display quizzes, then talk to Orlando Smith.

determinism.kudos: Deterministic one-time awards after the required correct answers are submitted for each display.
determinism.experience: Deterministic fixed skill XP after full quiz completion and the Orlando conversation.
determinism.random_or_discovery_component: None recorded for the award mechanics; answers are player responses, not loot rolls.

digsite_uncleaned_find_displays.location: Roped-off southern cleaning area on the Varrock Museum ground floor

tools_and_inputs.source_of_required_tools: All five required tools/equipment pieces can be collected from the cleaning area's south-wall tool rack.
tools_and_inputs.specimen_input: Dig site specimen rocks from the nearby specimen-rock pile are used on an empty specimen table to create a cleaned result.
tools_and_inputs.consumption: The required tools/equipment are reusable. Each cleaning attempt consumes one specimen rock into one result; the source supports taking specimen rocks repeatedly.

digsite_uncleaned_find_displays.claim_sequence: For a first eligible find, show it to a museum archaeologist, then place it in the stated display case. Each display grants its one-time 10 Kudos when filled.

determinism.display_award: The 10-Kudos award is fixed once the corresponding first-time find has been discovered and placed.
determinism.find_acquisition: Random/discovery-dependent. Cleaning can yield many non-display items, and the source does not provide a bounded number of specimens required to discover all five display finds.
determinism.not_auto_complete: Completion of The Dig Site unlocks cleaning only. It neither grants the 50 Kudos nor guarantees that any particular specimen has already been found or displayed.

other_random_outputs_not_counted_toward_.clean_necklace: A possible cleaned result with no Kudos. Showing it to an archaeologist teaches the account the Digsite-pendant enchantment; it is not assumed obtained.
other_random_outputs_not_counted_toward_.storage_crate_material: Other cleaned finds may be deposited in the storage crate for rewards, including a possible antique lamp. These are variable/random outputs and no XP is treated as fixed by this record.

historian_minas_timeline_claims.location: Varrock Museum first floor, beside the stairs
historian_minas_timeline_claims.claim_mechanic: Talk to Historian Minas and exchange information for each completed eligible quest. A claim is a separate one-time Museum interaction; a quest appearing below is a prerequisite for its claim, not evidence that the quest or its Museum claim is complete.

claims.additional_claim_input: Dagon'hai history, obtained from the Varrock Palace library
A complete set of ghostly robes

fixed_and_deferred_outputs.kudos: Each listed claim has a fixed one-time Kudos value after its own quest-completion and any stated additional claim input are satisfied.
fixed_and_deferred_outputs.lamps: Lamp XP amounts are fixed, but each lamp's eligible target skill is selected by the player and must meet its listed minimum level. No lamp XP is automatically assigned to a skill.
fixed_and_deferred_outputs.quest_outcomes: This record does not restate each quest's own rewards or assume any quest path, skill state, items, or combat readiness needed to complete it.

do_not_auto_complete: What Lies Below claim without Dagon'hai history
Curse of the Empty Lord claim without a complete ghostly-robe set
modeling_boundary.independence: The fifteen claims are independent contribution records. They must be represented as individually observed/completed account state, not as a single action that inserts 80 Kudos.

factual_modeling_notes.pre_bone_voyage_dependency_boundary: Fossil displays provide another 72 total Kudos but require Bone Voyage and therefore cannot satisfy Bone Voyage's own prerequisite. They are excluded from the pre-Bone Voyage contribution maximum.

threshold_xp_not_auto_claimed.note: These are fixed threshold rewards but are not outputs of a particular quiz, find display, or Minas quest claim and should remain separately claimable.

records.confidence: high for the fixed awards, current caps, access gates, tools, display cases, and Minas claim table; medium for the clean-necklace and storage-crate descriptions because their possible outputs are recorded only as non-Kudos random branches, without asserting rates.
